description: Source code for mcuboot shell commands in Zephyr RTOS, providing functions for image management, boot confirmation, upgrade requests, and recovery modes via shell interface.

methods.name: swap_state_magic_str
methods.description: Converts swap state magic byte to string.

methods.name: swap_type_str
methods.description: Converts swap type byte to string.

methods.name: swap_state_flag_str
methods.description: Converts swap state flag byte to string.

methods.name: cmd_mcuboot_erase
methods.description: Handles shell command to erase a specified image bank.

methods.name: cmd_mcuboot_confirm
methods.description: Handles shell command to confirm the current image.

methods.name: cmd_mcuboot_request_upgrade
methods.description: Handles shell command to request an upgrade, optionally permanent.

methods.name: cmd_mcuboot_serial_recovery
methods.description: Handles shell command to set serial recovery mode and reboot.

methods.name: cmd_mcuboot_info_area
methods.description: Displays information about a specific boot area.

methods.name: cmd_mcuboot_info
methods.description: Displays overall MCUboot status and area info.
